title: test(verify): re-set harness.required-providers's test-budget to 70 s on the 10 s grid
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DG44bgtJm8kWx4oK68re6GX)_

Fixes #37710
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：只改一个测试文件头上记的耗时预算数字，不影响任何功能。
- 属于测试耗时预算治理，替预算检查把一个过期数字改成实测值。
- 数字不准只会让慢测试预警失真；可直接撤回这一行。
- 无。

## What changes

Line 2 of `packages/verify/src/harness.required-providers.test.ts`: `test-budget: 28` becomes `test-budget: 70`, and the stale measurement narrative is replaced by the post-#37708 CI reading.

- Reading: scheduled CI run 45914939800, job Test Core (10/10) 140232535871, head 80519b5991 (a descendant of the #37708 merge 6b60f8860a); this file took 53747 ms.
- Rule used (the gate's own text in `readTestBudget`): measured CI reading x 1.25 (`CEILING_HEADROOM`), rounded up to the next 10 s: 53.7 x 1.25 = 67.1, so 70.
- The old line also lacked the `: ` after the CLASS; the gate's grammar is `SECONDS — CLASS: REASON`, which the new line satisfies (it already had the colon after the class text).
- It is the only post-#37708 reading of this file on main (the push run 45915335818 did not run it).

## Tests

- `readTestBudget` on the edited file: `{ seconds: 70, cls: 'spawns the real producer once per single-cause fixture', line: 2 }`, no refusal (before: refused "28 s is not on the 10 s grid").
- `check-nul-bytes` exit 0; `check-issue-citations` exit 0; `overlap-check` VERDICT clean (#37676 shares the file, merges cleanly).

## Acceptance notes

- Test-only comment-line change, nothing published: `skip-changeset`.
- The file's own vitest was not rerun locally: no code changed, and the reading comes from CI.

## Verification

Run `node -e "import('./scripts/measure-test-shard-timings.mjs').then(m=>console.log(m.readTestBudget(require('fs').readFileSync('packages/verify/src/harness.required-providers.test.ts','utf8'),'f').seconds))"`; expect `70`.
